title: VTA Attestation — Config Report — payload
description: Asks an agent for fresh attestation evidence committing to the configuration it booted, bound to a nonce the verifier chose. The outer document members (id, type, issuer, recipient, issuedAt, expiresAt, proof) are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

nonce.description: Thirty-two bytes the verifier generated for this request, lowercase hex. The agent binds exactly this into the evidence.

Response.title: VTA Attestation Config Report — response payload

configDigestSha384.description: SHA-384 of the decoded configView bytes, base64 (standard). A convenience: the verifier recomputes it, and a mismatch with either the view or the evidence is a refusal.

configView.description: The canonical, secret-free view of the configuration the agent booted, base64 (standard): the exact bytes whose SHA-384 the evidence binds as its user data.

nonce.description: The request's nonce, echoed. A verifier checks the nonce inside the evidence, not this.

teeType.description: The platform that produced the evidence. Informational and not covered by the evidence.

evidence.description: The platform's quote, base64 (a COSE_Sign1 attestation document for nitro).

generatedAt.description: When the evidence was produced. Informational: freshness comes from the nonce.
